reason: One 12-symbol x 13-month historical backbone with up to 10 GiB network cache cannot be admitted based only on 17 offline tests: current Test Executor launcher binds SC001_DATA_ROOT to job-local output/data, BM_TEST_NETWORK_PROFILE not SC001_NETWORK_PROFILE, ReadWritePaths only to job output, completed job output retention 7 days. Verify static technical facts and future durable resource admission before any body access.
exact_questions: Static confirm Test Executor job environment: SC001_DATA_ROOT location and lifetime, network-profile variable name, read/write mount boundary, and output retention; distinguish deployed runtime evidence from installer claims.
Static confirm frozen H1 acquisition env requirements, --ack-resource-id semantics, actual cache path, and the 12*13 immutable data identity without touching market bodies.
Does job-local SC001_DATA_ROOT provide a VERIFIED shareable resource across jobs as required by resource coordination? Fail-closed if unproven.
Can network acquisition run with existing Test Executor 900-second maximum and one-job cap, given 312 objects and frozen 1248 requests? Do not assume yes from offline test.
Can prejob disk headroom be proved against max(10GiB,15%FS) + expected peak without lowering reserves? Is same-host collector isolation proven?
Compare the source metadata qualification vs body acquisition RESERVATION requirements. Do not claim metadata-only prior reservation covers the new body RESOURCE_ID.

Identify at most one minimal executable T0 successor proving missing env/storage/disk capability before any T1; no host mutation or new service. Escalate as USER_GATE_REQUIRED if actual host mount or protected collector permissions change requires T3.
